column2: [intro]
I have a problem I must confess,
I stack them in the closet, books I never address.
They stare at me with such despair,
Like incomplete tales that linger in the air.
I am the king of the unfinished,
Pages turn to dust, but I remain unfished.
I am the master of the incomplete,
Abandoned novels, but my life's a festive beat.
I start with passion, eyes so bright,
But soon I grow weary, can’t finish the fight.
Too many stories calling my name,
I jump from one book to another, it's my game.
I am the king of the unfinished,
Pages turn to dust, but I remain unfished.
I am the master of the incomplete,
Abandoned novels, but my life's a festive beat.
